title: Faster search results for account and workspace pages
summary: Search results now return faster for large customer workspaces after backend index tuning.
details: This release reduces query latency on account, workspace, and settings pages. The rollout also adds safer fallbacks when an index is cold, which lowers timeout risk during peak usage.

title: Bulk actions for support inbox triage
summary: Support teams can now close, assign, or tag multiple conversations in a single action.
details: The feature is rolling out gradually to teams with higher ticket volume. It is designed to reduce repetitive triage work while keeping activity logs and ownership history intact.

title: New weekly retention dashboard for product leads
summary: A new dashboard view highlights cohort retention trends and segment comparisons.
details: The dashboard adds weekly retention trends, breakdowns by customer segment, and export support for review meetings. The team is validating final metric definitions before general availability.
